content.short: Explorer for wallet activity and chain statistics, popular with airdrop hunters.
content.description: LayerHub lets anyone paste a wallet address and see how active it has been across chains, including transaction counts, volumes and protocol usage. It also tracks daily transactions and total users for networks from Base to newer chains and testnets, which makes it a common tool for checking eligibility before airdrops.
content.meta: Look up any wallet's on-chain activity and compare chain usage stats across mainnets and testnets on LayerHub.
